answer_card.title: Survey answer types
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Text**: single line (min/max length)
- **Textarea**: multi-line (min/max length)
- **Password**: treated as sensitive
- **Multiple Choice (single select)** and **(multiple select)**: options one per line in *Multiple Choice Options*
- **Integer** and **Float**

Each question also has an *Answer variable name* (no spaces), *Required*, length limits and a *Default answer*. Use **Edit Order** to drag questions into order.
